name: women-empowerment-marketplace
description: Full-stack digital commerce engine empowering women artisans & local cottage entrepreneurs.

scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('client/dist/index.html')){ console.log('✨ Building frontend bundle...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); } const s=require('child_process').spawn('node', ['server/server.js'], {stdio:'inherit'}); s.on('exit', process.exit);"
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('node', ['server/server.js'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"

author: Women Artisan Collective
